author: mfhansen
title: LLM accuracy tests fail with TypeError: genai_gen_text() got an unexpected keyword argument 'context'
signature: typeerror genai_gen_text got an unexpected keyword argument context|Dependencies

failed_jobs.name: LLM accuracy iGPU tests / LLM accuracy GPU tests
failed_jobs.symptom: All 4 GPU accuracy_conformance test cases (TinyLlama INT8/INT4, Qwen2-0.5B INT8/INT4) fail with TypeError calling genai_gen_text(context=...)

failed_jobs.name: LLM accuracy CPU tests / LLM accuracy CPU tests
failed_jobs.symptom: All 4 CPU accuracy_conformance test cases (same model/precision matrix) fail with the identical TypeError

key_errors:
File "/__w/openvino/openvino/tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py", line 250, in test_accuracy_conformance
    _, all_metrics = evaluator.score(target_model, evaluator.get_generation_fn())
  File "/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/whowhatbench/text_evaluator.py", line 236, in _generate_data
    output = gen_answer_fn(
TypeError: genai_gen_text() got an unexpected keyword argument 'context'
root_cause: The installed `whowhatbench` package's text_evaluator._generate_data() invokes the GenAI generation callback with a `context` keyword argument, but the `genai_gen_text()` helper bundled with the currently resolved `optimum-intel`/`openvino-genai` wheel set does not accept that parameter, raising TypeError on every accuracy_conformance test case (both CPU and GPU devices, all model/precision combinations). PR #39512 only edits docs/sphinx_setup/_static/benchmarks_files/llm_models_7-368H.csv and cannot influence this failure; it is a pre-existing, unresolved dependency-version-skew between whowhatbench and the GenAI model-loader helper, now recorded 6 times since 2026-11-05.
reproduction_steps: 1. Check out the merge-queue commit a468da78d298e347a1ba2f1ff5cae920ebdecb6b. 2. Install test deps per tests/llm/requirements.txt (resolved versions match the CI log, e.g. optimum-intel-2.0.0, openvino-genai-2026.4.1.0, whowhatbench 1.0.0.dev0+ca69756b). 3. Run `python3 -m pytest tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py -k CPU --tb native`. 4. Observe TypeError: genai_gen_text() got an unexpected keyword argument 'context' raised from whowhatbench/text_evaluator.py:236.
recommended_actions: Pin or bump whowhatbench to a version whose text_evaluator._generate_data() matches the current genai_gen_text() signature, or update genai_gen_text() to accept 'context'.
Inspect the model-loader helper that defines genai_gen_text() (resolved from optimum-intel/openvino-genai per tests/llm/requirements.txt) and reconcile its signature with whowhatbench's call site.

Add a fast pre-flight check that calls genai_gen_text() with the exact kwargs whowhatbench's text_evaluator passes, so a future incompatible upgrade fails immediately instead of after the full accuracy suite runs.
prevention_strategies: Pin whowhatbench, optimum-intel and openvino-genai together with compatible version ranges in tests/llm/requirements.txt, and add a unit/smoke test asserting the genai_gen_text() signature accepts whowhatbench's expected kwargs, so incompatible dependency bumps are caught before they reach merge-queue LLM accuracy jobs.
historical_context: Identical signature (6cf9cf0d8f5c0a43) previously recorded 5 times between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-12 (runs 41968975027, 42251178965, 42647164506, 42857529315, 43242891184), always in the LLM accuracy CPU/GPU jobs and always categorized Dependencies. This run raises the count to 6, confirming an unresolved, recurring dependency-version-skew that has not yet been fixed upstream.
